fusions.name: Ramming Prow
fusions.desc: A ramming blow that deals 16 damage and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Wake Spray
fusions.desc: Drives the wake forward in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sunken Hull
fusions.desc: Raises a hull of reef 6 tiles long that blocks enemies for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Ballast Shift
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
